applicationIntelligence.centralQuestion: What exactly changed in system behavior because of this lesson?
applicationIntelligence.rule: Every lesson is routed to Ignore, Experiment, or Adopt. A lesson becomes intelligence only when behavior changes and metrics improve.

headlinePatternMemory.rule: Headline learning stores reusable construction patterns and repair outcomes, not publisher phrasing.

repairReview.rule: Repairs are no longer counted as done until the Editor re-reviews the repaired draft and records whether it passed, changed failure type, or still needs teaching.

minimumRules: body must include intro, body, and ending
body should be at least five paragraphs or 900 characters
article must include enough full-read or extracted factual material
public article cannot contain internal instructions, copied noise, or editorial-language drift
Editorial Coach must approve repeated phrasing, copied wording, evidence support, transitions, and template-language checks

secondPassApproval.rule: Second-pass repair rebuilds headlines from Story Snapshot/Dossier, resubmits them, separates headline/body/image repairs, and measures headline pass plus final approval.

publicProcessLanguageLearning.ownerDirection: Do not reject visible articles for this issue when safe cleanup is possible; clean them and teach upstream systems.

upstreamTeaching.Writer: Do not say what CE Media, the Brain, the dossier, or the reporting trail is doing in reader-facing article copy.
upstreamTeaching.StoryDossierBuilder: Keep workflow fields private and hand the Writer only reportable facts, timeline, entities, and public context.
upstreamTeaching.Validator: Block or return any process-language leak before publication unless Publishing Editor has already removed it.

encodingArtifactLearning.validatorRule: Reject or repair encoded entities, mojibake, replacement characters, malformed entity fragments, and degraded smart-quote prefixes before publication.

upstreamTeaching.StoryDossierBuilder: Do not pass encoded source fragments to Writer.
upstreamTeaching.Writer: Write from cleaned facts, not raw encoded snippets.
upstreamTeaching.Publisher: Count publication only after visible copy passes encoding scan.

generalizedFailureClassLearning.rule: Top blockers are grouped by failure class first and issue code second so future similar failures are repaired automatically.

headline-integrity.label: Headline integrity failure
headline-integrity.detect: Any scrambled, clipped, generic, copied, or body-mismatched headline, even when the exact bad words are new.
headline-integrity.repair: Rebuild headline from Story Dossier and completed body; resubmit headline-only when body is otherwise sound.
headline-integrity.prevent: Headline Generator must use actor + action + consequence and verify body overlap before editor review.

language-integrity.label: Language integrity failure
language-integrity.detect: Any incomplete word, clipped sentence, mojibake, grammar break, or noisy copied fragment, not just previously seen strings.
language-integrity.repair: Publishing Editor cleans or removes bad sentence, normalizes encoding, rebuilds missing context from dossier facts, then resubmits.
language-integrity.prevent: Run generalized paragraph language checks before validation.

story-identity-integrity.label: Story identity failure
story-identity-integrity.detect: Any paragraph/source/headline whose primary event differs from the canonical Story Dossier event.
story-identity-integrity.repair: Split cluster, remove off-event evidence, rebuild one-event dossier, rewrite affected sections.
story-identity-integrity.prevent: Every paragraph must map to one event id or explicit dossier relationship before writing.

originality-and-public-copy.label: Originality and public-copy failure
originality-and-public-copy.detect: Any repeated phrasing, summary/body duplication, backend-process language, or generic template wording.
originality-and-public-copy.repair: Draft Optimization rewrites summary/transitions and removes internal language before editor review.
originality-and-public-copy.prevent: Compare against CE recent output and forbidden public-copy classes before publication.

evidence-depth.label: Evidence depth failure
evidence-depth.detect: Any article that lacks enough verified facts, context, or full article structure for its publication tier.
evidence-depth.repair: Return to Evidence Engine and Dossier Builder to expand verified facts, then regenerate weak sections.
evidence-depth.prevent: Writer must prove it used a complete Story Dossier before first draft.

tabFillHardPush.lesson: Rejected articles should generalize issue classes, rebuild from clean event facts, regenerate headlines from the completed article body, then resubmit to publisher instead of sitting in storage.
tabFillHardPush.prevention: Collectors and dossier builders must send category-specific clean facts to the writer; publisher bridge must not rely on rejected currentHeadline values.
